decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposal is considered acceptable, because of its position, design and appearance, would relate well to its site and would not be harmful to the living conditions of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  The development is in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan, and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines (2002).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the buildings are occupied).

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as No.96 Mornington Crescent.

Condition : 7 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the any wall of the wall of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
description: Erection of a two storey side extension and erection of a single storey rear extension to house.
